title: CM-Align: Consistency-based Multilingual Alignment for Large Language Models
authors_zh: Xue Zhang、Yunlong Liang、Fandong Meng 等（北京交通大学、腾讯微信 AI）
paper_type_zh: 跨语言一致性偏好数据构造与多语言对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合构造多语言偏好数据并用于直接偏好优化的读者。
one_line: CM-Align constructs multilingual DPO pairs by selecting a reliable English anchor and cross-lingually consistent responses.
CM-Align 用英语锚点与跨语言一致性构造多语言 DPO 偏好对。
why: It treats the English reference and target-language pair construction as explicit data-quality decisions.
inclusion_reason: Constructs chosen and rejected multilingual responses that DPO consumes from cross-lingual consistency decisions.

title: Problem
问题
html:
English-centric models are often better aligned in English than in other languages. Existing multilingual DPO pipelines commonly treat an English response as a reliable anchor and use translation or heuristic similarity to form chosen and rejected target-language answers.

CM-Align asks how to build multilingual preference pairs without assuming every English answer is sound. It first selects a dependable English anchor, then uses cross-lingual consistency to decide which target-language responses should train DPO.

以英语为中心的模型在英语中的对齐通常优于其他语言。已有多语言 DPO 流水线常把英语回答视为可靠锚点，并用翻译或启发式相似度构造优选和拒选的目标语言回答。

CM-Align 追问如何在不假定每个英语回答都可靠的情况下构造多语言偏好对。它先选择可信的英语锚点，再用跨语言一致性决定哪些目标语言回答应训练 DPO。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For each prompt, the model produces several English answers and keeps the answer most consistent with the others as an English reference. This reduces the chance that one poor English generation governs every downstream language.

The method then scores target-language answers against that reference with task-specific consistency criteria. The most consistent answer becomes chosen and the least consistent becomes rejected, turning cross-lingual agreement into the preference-record construction rule.

对于每个提示，模型生成若干英语回答，并保留与其他回答最一致的回答作为英语参考。这降低了一条较差英语生成控制所有下游语言的风险。

方法随后用任务特定的一致性标准为目标语言回答相对该参考打分。最一致的回答成为优选，最不一致的成为拒选，从而把跨语言一致性转化为偏好记录构造规则。

title: Method
方法
html:
CM-Align samples multiple responses in English and in every target language. It chooses the English response with the strongest self-consistency, then measures each non-English response against that anchor with metrics adapted to Math, Code, or general instruction following.

Each prompt-language group yields one chosen and one rejected answer. These constructed pairs are used in DPO, and the public implementation exposes the response sampling and consistency-based construction pipeline.

CM-Align 在英语和每种目标语言中采样多个回答。它选择自一致性最强的英语回答，然后使用适配数学、代码或通用指令跟随的指标，将每个非英语回答与该锚点比较。

每个提示—语言组产生一个优选和一个拒选回答。这些构造的回答对被用于 DPO，公开实现提供回答采样和基于一致性的构造流水线。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The EMNLP Findings paper evaluates three LLMs on Math, Code, and general instruction-following tasks. It reports that the consistency-based construction improves multilingual alignment and also generalizes to languages outside the construction set.

The paper compares against English-reference baselines that use translation probability, direct translated answers, or an additional aligned model for cross-lingual rewards. This supports the claimed construction choice in those settings, but the actual value of a consistency metric remains task-, language-, and model-dependent.

EMNLP Findings 论文在数学、代码和通用指令跟随任务上评估三个大模型。它报告基于一致性的构造改善多语言对齐，并能泛化到构造集合之外的语言。

论文与使用翻译概率、直接翻译回答或额外对齐模型计算跨语言奖励的英语参考基线比较。这支持这些设置中的构造选择，但一致性指标的实际价值仍取决于任务、语言和模型。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier pipelines usually choose an English response or translate it before forming a pair. CM-Align adds a separate anchor-selection decision and makes target-language preference labels depend on cross-lingual agreement with that selected anchor.

Its contribution is therefore a record-construction procedure, not a replacement DPO loss. By using task-specific criteria for three task types, it directly addresses the fact that translation similarity is not a reliable quality signal for open-ended, mathematical, or code responses.

较早流水线通常选择一条英语回答，或在构造回答对前翻译它。CM-Align 增加独立的锚点选择决策，并让目标语言偏好标签依赖于与该选定锚点的跨语言一致性。

因此，其贡献是记录构造程序，而不是替换 DPO 损失。通过为三类任务使用特定标准，它直接处理了翻译相似度对开放式、数学或代码回答并非可靠质量信号的问题。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The approach remains anchored in English, so an apparently consistent English reference can still encode English-centric bias or a shared error. Task-specific consistency metrics may not transfer to new domains or languages, and repeated multilingual sampling costs more than reusing a single translated answer. Translation, source-prompt licensing, and benchmark overlap must also be audited before reuse.
该方法仍以英语为锚，因此看似一致的英语参考仍可能编码英语中心偏见或共同错误。任务特定的一致性指标可能无法迁移到新领域或语言，重复多语言采样的成本也高于复用单条翻译回答。复用前还必须审计翻译、源提示许可证和基准重叠。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use CM-Align when multilingual preference data must be constructed from model outputs and direct translation is too brittle. It gives a clear separation between selecting a source-language anchor and selecting target-language pairs, which makes both decisions testable in an alignment pipeline.
当必须从模型输出构造多语言偏好数据、而直接翻译过于脆弱时，应使用 CM-Align。它清楚分离选择源语言锚点与选择目标语言回答对，使两项决策都可在对齐流水线中测试。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the anchor-selection and task-specific consistency definitions before the final DPO results. For reproduction, record the prompt translations, response-sampling configuration, languages, anchor choice, task metric, pair-construction rule, and whether evaluation languages were excluded from construction.
应在最终 DPO 结果之前先阅读锚点选择和任务特定一致性定义。复现时应记录提示翻译、回答采样配置、语言、锚点选择、任务指标、回答对构造规则，以及评估语言是否从构造中排除。
